title: Captain Lead From The Front (Chas McIvor)
style: country swing bluegrass banjo brass bongo fast beat 132bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections southern drawl harmonica fiddle steel guitar
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
I say son, the captain leads from the front
First tackle, first ruck, first carry
Never ask the team to do what you wont

[Verse 1]
The armband is heavy, son, it carries the weight
Decisions on penalties, kick or scrum, dont be late
Talk to the referee with respect, sir always
Build the relationship, never the rude phase

[Pre-Chorus]
Know the laws of the game inside and out
Know your players, what they can do, no doubt
Lift the heads of the tired, calm the angry
The captain is the steady hand, never wangly

[Chorus]
Captain lead from the front, son
First tackle, first ruck, work begun
Talk to the ref with sir respect
Lift the team, never deflect

[Verse 2]
In the huddle keep it short and clear
Three messages maximum, then we hear
Tactical changes, refocus on basics
Stay positive, son, the team mimics

[Bridge - Chas spoken]
I say boy, the great captains lift others
When the team is down, the captain mothers
When the team is high, the captain steadies
Reading the room, son, every minute already

[Chorus]
Captain lead from the front, son
First tackle, first ruck, work begun
Talk to the ref with sir respect
Lift the team, never deflect

[Outro]
First in, hardest work
Ref respect, no smirk
Lift the heads, calm the storm
Thats my boy, captain warm
